sentences.text:
So far as the applicant in Anticipatory Bail Application No.991 of 2019, namely, SANDIP S/O.
KAILASAPPA LAKADE is concerned, except his name mentioned in the FIR, it is not clear as to in what connection he has been arraigned as an accused in this crime.
Learned APP to take specific instructions about his involvement in commission of the crime, so also about his antecedents.

However, Until further orders, in the event of arrest of the applicant in Anticipatory Bail Application No.991 of 2019, namely, SANDIP S/O. KAILASAPPA LAKADE in connection with crime no.161 of 2019 registered at Ghansawangi Police Station, District Jalna for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, he be released on bail on furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- with one surety of the like amount, on the following conditions :
a.
The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 08.00 am to 11.00 am.

( V. K. JADHAV, J.) vre/
